title: ERC-4337 UserOperation Math
description: Recomputes the ERC-4337 account-abstraction userOpHash from a caller-supplied UserOperation, computes the EntryPoint's required prefund from caller-supplied gas limits, and reconciles a declared paymaster charge against a charge recomputed from declared inputs. The EntryPoint version is a mandatory declared parameter, never inferred: v0.6 hashes a 10-word UserOperation pack, v0.7 hashes an 8-word PackedUserOperation in which verificationGasLimit and callGasLimit pack into accountGasLimits and maxPriorityFeePerGas and maxFeePerGas pack into gasFees. The prefund formulas differ too: v0.6 multiplies verificationGasLimit by three when a paymaster is present because that limit also caps postOp, while v0.7 adds the paymaster's own verification and postOp gas limits parsed from fixed offsets inside paymasterAndData. Both versions are supported; an unrecognised version is refused, never approximated. L1 data and blob fees are never derived, since after EIP-4844 they depend on the inclusion-time L1 basefee and blob basefee: an L1 data fee enters reconciliation only when declared, and its absence is reported as a named gap. block.basefee is never fetched either, so with differing fee caps the effective gas price is null with the reason unless a basefee is declared. keccak256 comes from the already-vendored, pinned noble-hashes bundle; the ABI encoding scheme is public-spec arithmetic on top of it, not hand-rolled crypto. Zero network calls and zero chain reads. Makes no claim that any operation was settled, accepted, included, or final, and no claim about signature validity, which the ERC-4337 spec excludes from the hashed struct.

entryPointVersion.description: EntryPoint version the UserOperation targets: "0.6" or "0.7". Mandatory, never inferred -- the two versions hash different structs.

entryPoint.description: 20-byte hex address of the EntryPoint. Hashed into the userOpHash, so never defaulted.

chainId.description: Declared chain id hashed into the userOpHash. A declared input, never a chain selector and never resolved.

sender.description: UserOperation.sender -- 20-byte hex address of the account.

initCode.description: UserOperation.initCode -- hex byte string, "0x" when the account already exists.

paymasterAndData.description: UserOperation.paymasterAndData -- hex byte string, "0x" for none. Under v0.7 the first 52 bytes carry the paymaster address and its verification and postOp gas limits.

callGasLimit.description: Caller-supplied callGasLimit -- uint256. Packed into accountGasLimits under v0.7.

verificationGasLimit.description: Caller-supplied verificationGasLimit -- uint256. Packed into accountGasLimits under v0.7.

maxFeePerGas.description: Caller-supplied maxFeePerGas -- uint256. Packed into gasFees under v0.7.

maxPriorityFeePerGas.description: Caller-supplied maxPriorityFeePerGas -- uint256. Packed into gasFees under v0.7.

declaredBaseFeePerGas.description: Optional. Caller-DECLARED block basefee used to derive the effective gas price when the fee caps differ. Never fetched; absent it the price is reported as null with the reason.

declaredActualGasUsed.description: Optional. Caller-declared actualGasUsed to reconcile against. Never read from a chain or receipt.

declaredActualGasCostWei.description: Optional. Caller-declared actualGasCost charged, in wei, to reconcile against a charge recomputed from declared inputs.

declaredL1DataFeeWei.description: Optional. Caller-DECLARED L1 data or blob fee component. Never derived -- post-EIP-4844 it depends on the inclusion-time L1 basefee. Absent, its omission is reported as a named gap.

reconciliationToleranceWei.description: Optional. Absolute wei tolerance within which a residual counts as reconciled. Defaults to 0.

mcp_tool_definition.name: recompute_erc4337_userop_math
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes the ERC-4337 userOpHash under a declared EntryPoint version (0.6 or 0.7), computes the required prefund from caller-supplied gas limits, and reconciles a declared paymaster charge against one recomputed from declared inputs. Never derives L1 data or blob fees and never fetches block.basefee. Zero network calls, no settlement claim.
